Markets.title: Indian finance hub eyes dual share model to kickstart public offers: Report
Markets.summary: Indian regulators are evaluating a proposal to allow companies to issue dual-class shares for listings in domestic markets and GIFT City. This model, featuring one rupee-denominated class and one dollar-denominated class, aims to boost primary market activity in GIFT City.

Markets.title: Who is Roaring Kitty? The man behind GameStop's meme rally
Markets.summary: Keith Gill, known online as Roaring Kitty, returned to social media after a nearly two-year absence with a cryptic post. His return caused GameStop shares to surge and revived the retail investor meme-stock rally of 2021.

Markets.title: Treasury rally spills over to Indian bonds, debt supply slows move
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds gained slightly following a rally in US Treasuries. Investors are now closely watching an upcoming weekly debt auction and potential rate hikes from the Reserve Bank of India amid inflation and oil price concerns.

Markets.title: Rupee rises past 93 vs USD as portfolio inflows, bear retreat fuel rally
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened past 93 against the US dollar for the first time since April. This rally was driven by over $12 billion in foreign portfolio investments in November.

Markets.title: Rupee strengthens 17 paise to 93.15 against US dollar in early trade
Markets.summary: The rupee strengthened by 17 paise to 93.15 against the US dollar in early trade on Friday, driven by strong foreign fund inflows. Analysts attribute the currency's resilience to a slight positive bias supported by declining crude and gold prices.

Markets.title: Anthropic shares close 17% higher on first day of trading amid protest, arrests outside Nasdaq
Markets.summary: Anthropic shares closed 17% higher on their first day of trading. The stock debut was accompanied by protests and arrests outside the Nasdaq exchange.

Geo-Political.title: UK and EU to agree youth mobility scheme, BBC understands
Geo-Political.summary: The UK and the EU are expected to agree on a youth mobility scheme at Friday's summit. New agreements regarding food trade and carbon emissions will also be discussed during the meeting.

Geo-Political.title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': Life inside Yemeni city besieged by Houthis
Geo-Political.summary: BBC correspondent Orla Guerin spoke with seven residents trapped inside the Yemeni city of Taiz. The city has been cut off from the outside world for weeks by Houthi forces.

Geo-Political.title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
Geo-Political.summary: A major Russian missile attack struck three bridges in Kyiv and killed five people. The strikes occurred following a successful Ukrainian attack on the Crimean Bridge.

Geo-Political.title: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut
Geo-Political.summary: Anthropic has debuted on the stock market as the first purely artificial intelligence company to go public. This initial public offering serves as a major financial test for the broader AI industry.

Geo-Political.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
Geo-Political.summary: The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar's military committed genocide against the Rohingya minority during a 2017 crackdown. The unprecedented verdict follows a violent campaign that resulted in the deaths of thousands of Rohingya.

Geo-Political.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
Geo-Political.summary: European leaders meeting in Berlin stated they share a united negotiating position. They announced Europe is ready to hold talks with Russia to end the war in Ukraine.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications and features work without needing to view the source code. This eliminates the traditional requirement of spending months learning disassemblers and reading assembly code.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course on the topic. They achieved this free organic recommendation without using paid advertising.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to help creators improve their content production in 2025. It explains how these technologies are changing the digital landscape and simplifying the creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that drive industry innovation and efficiency. These advanced tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article helps readers navigate the crowded market of AI content generator tools in 2022. It explains that these tools offer an effective and efficient way to create engaging, relevant content for audiences.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighing ways to boost long-term credit to manufacturing: DEA secretary Anuradha Thakur
Data & Insights.summary: DEA Secretary Anuradha Thakur stated that the government is exploring methods to increase long-term credit for the manufacturing sector. She also urged large companies to engage in public-private partnerships, collaborate with smaller businesses, and resolve wage stagnation.

Data & Insights.title: More economic red signals in October—but not everywhere, shows Mint tracker
Data & Insights.summary: The Mint economic tracker shows warning signals flashing across India in October, though producer and industrial segments remain resilient. However, the second half of the year is expected to be more challenging as the positive impacts of GST rate cuts and interest rate reductions diminish.

Data & Insights.title: UK inflation hits one-year high of 3.6%: Why are markets less convinced of another rate hike? | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: UK inflation rose to a one-year high of 3.6% in October due to increased fuel prices and tobacco taxes. Despite this increase, steady core and services inflation reduced market expectations for a December interest rate hike by the Bank of England.

Data & Insights.title: Trump, Xi, Putin unite $1.48 Trillion military might at Shenzhen: Will nukes be on the table? Why it matters
Data & Insights.summary: US President Donald Trump has arrived in Shenzhen, China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. He is scheduled to hold a high-stakes meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday.

Data & Insights.title: Soybean oil's share rises in India's edible oil import mix
Data & Insights.summary: India imported 5.83 million tonnes of soybean oil during the 2025-26 period. This accounted for a rising share of the country's total 16.92 million tonnes of edible oil imports.

Data & Insights.title: Could AI boom trigger a jobs crisis? The risks Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sees beyond productivity gains
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh warns that the AI boom could cause widespread job displacement through automation. Alternatively, he notes it may drive faster economic growth or trigger a slowdown if market expectations fail.

India.title: "Paid To Defame India": BJP On Rahul Gandhi's "Compromised PM" Post
India.summary: The BJP criticized Rahul Gandhi after he claimed on social media that a compromised Prime Minister cannot participate in high-level global talks. Gandhi's remark accompanied a photo featuring Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin.

India.title: 'Because Of His Name': Congress vs BJP Over Siraj's Exclusion From NZ Test
India.summary: Congress and the BJP are engaged in a political dispute regarding the exclusion of cricketer Mohammed Siraj from the playing XI for the first Test against New Zealand. Cricketing greats Sunil Gavaskar and Ravi Shastri have also publicly questioned the decision to leave Siraj out of the team.

India.title: NIOS 2027 Board Exams: Class 10, 12 Registration Window Opens On November 21
India.summary: Registration for the NIOS Class 10 and 12 board exams for 2027 will begin on November 21, 2026. Eligible students can apply through the official website at sdmis.nios.ac.in.

India.title: All About Yogi Adityanath's Ancestral Village, Parents And Siblings
India.summary: Following the death of his mother, Savitri Devi, public attention has focused on Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's family roots in Uttarakhand. Despite his prominent political status, his relatives continue to live a humble life in their native village of Panchur.

India.title: Yusuf Pathan To Get Part Of Disputed Gujarat Plot For Free, Rest At Discount
India.summary: The Vadodara Municipal Corporation's general body voted to give former cricketer Yusuf Pathan a portion of a disputed plot for free while selling the rest at a discount. Mayor Geeta Makwana stated that the proposal had previously been reviewed by the VMC Standing Committee before receiving final approval.

India.title: Yogi Adityanath's Mother Savitri Devi Dies At 91 In Uttarakhand Village
India.summary: Savitri Devi, the mother of Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, passed away at the age of 91 in her Uttarakhand village. She died around 11 a.m. on Friday, leaving her family in deep mourning.

General.title: What the Brussels summit could mean for the Brexit deal
General.summary: BBC political editor Chris Mason examines potential UK-EU agreements regarding food, energy, and youth mobility. The analysis focuses on what these prospective deals at the Brussels summit could mean for Brexit.

General.title: Tens of thousands of UK fridges secured from hackers in secret nationwide operation
General.summary: A secret nationwide UK operation recently secured tens of thousands of commercial refrigerators from hackers. Businesses including supermarkets, warehouses, restaurants, and stadiums rushed to make these connected devices safe.

General.title: Massive hope for pancreatic cancer pill after trial saw tumours vanish
General.summary: A daily pill called daraxonrasib has shown promising results in clinical trials by shrinking and potentially eliminating pancreatic cancer tumours. This new treatment offers significant hope for patients fighting one of the deadliest forms of cancer.

General.title: Calls for consent law change after Joanne Young rape case
General.summary: Joanne Young and her daughter are calling for a change to the law regarding sexual consent following her rape case. They made this demand together to address deficiencies in the current legal framework.

General.title: Mouldy, infested housing for vulnerable people sold as ethical investments abroad
General.summary: Vulnerable people are living in mouldy, infested housing that has been sold abroad as ethical investments. The BBC found that these properties are marketed at premium prices with false claims of government-backed returns.

General.title: UK braces for coldest night of autumn so far with temperature of -10C forecast
General.summary: Friday night is forecast to be the coldest night of the autumn so far in the UK. Temperatures are expected to drop as low as minus 10 degrees Celsius.
